column1: # Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night, 1.60 (v851968), SDK 7.6.0
# Unreal Engine on NVN, with CRIWARE audio and NintendoSDK_movie
# The NPDM declares 70 MiB of system resource. Main maps memory in the alias region without setting a heap.
# On the Mac the host reserves 64 GiB of alias space. The game reaches beyond 40 GiB during startup.
# Unreal's rhi.SyncInterval is found by its registered name. One vsync per frame yields 60 fps.
# Two shared v1 shader archives supply the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders.
